details: This package is an install-time proof-of-concept beacon. Its postinstall hook runs `node index.js`, the package's only code file, which collects the host name and working directory, generates a random test identifier, and sends them as JSON ({"event":"authorized-poc-test","testId":"<uuid>","status":"executed"}) in an HTTPS POST to hxxps://webhook[.]site/b4ea4473-01d9-4763-9e39-3b02063219d5. It reads no environment variables, credentials, token files or other files, executes no downloaded code, and contains no obfuscation; its stated and coded purpose is to verify that the install hook executes. The package name suggests a private-scope/dependency-confusion probe.
